requirements.quote:
Endpoints responding to an apparent key update MUST NOT generate a
   timing side-channel signal that might indicate that the Key Phase bit
   was invalid (see Section 9.5).
requirements.condition: When responding to a packet that appears to initiate a key update.
requirements.required_behavior: Process valid and invalid apparent Key Phase changes without an observable timing distinction that reveals invalidity.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Generating a timing side-channel signal that indicates the Key Phase bit was invalid.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled valid and invalid Key Phase inputs can be measured statistically for distinguishable processing-time distributions.

requirements.quote:
For a short period after a key
   update completes, up to the PTO, endpoints MAY defer generation of
   the next set of receive packet protection keys.
requirements.condition: After a key update completes and the next receive-key set has not yet been generated.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate the next receive packet-protection key set no later than one PTO after completion of the update.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Deferring generation beyond the PTO bound.
requirements.why_checkable: A simulated clock can compare the key-update completion time, PTO value, and next-key generation event.

requirements.quote:
Once generated, the next set of packet protection keys SHOULD be
   retained, even if the packet that was received was subsequently
   discarded.
requirements.condition: Once the next set of receive packet-protection keys has been generated.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain the generated next-key set even if the packet that triggered generation is later discarded.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Discarding the next-key set solely because the triggering packet was discarded.
requirements.why_checkable: A forged apparent update can trigger generation and later packet discard while key-store state is observed.

requirements.quote:
For this reason, endpoints MUST be able to retain two sets of packet
   protection keys for receiving packets: the current and the next.
requirements.required_behavior: Support simultaneous retention of two receive-key sets: the current set and the next set.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using a receive-key store incapable of retaining both sets concurrently.
requirements.why_checkable: Key-store capacity and runtime state can be tested with current and next keys installed together.
